description: Edge case: burn amount exceeds S[t] + M[t] so the naive next_supply would be negative. Pins Security Invariant 2 (Non-Negative Supply) — the computed next_supply is clamped to 0. This cannot happen on mainnet today, but the guard exists so a future bug that produces a giant burn event cannot drive the state below zero.

periods.label: burn exceeds supply + minted: next_supply clamped to 0
